cmd.desc: Invite tracking: who invited whom, counts and a leaderboard
cmd.view: Show the invite counts of a member (counts only)
cmd.leaderboard: Show who invited the most members
cmd.bonus: Change the bonus on a member's invite count (staff)
cmd.bonusAdd: Add bonus invites to a member
cmd.bonusRemove: Take bonus invites away from a member
cmd.reset: Reset invite counts: one member, or the whole server (staff)
cmd.resetUser: Only this member (leave empty for the whole server)
cmd.setup: Where to set up invite tracking (dashboard link)

title: Invites
off: Invite tracking is off in this server. An admin can turn it on on the dashboard (Invites page).

error.dbDown: The database is not responding right now, so nothing was read or changed. Try again in a minute.

source.bot: Mewvo (added back through Verify with Discord)
source.ambiguous: one of several invites (could not tell which)
source.not_ready: unknown (the invite list was still loading)
source.no_permission: unknown (Mewvo needs Manage Server to track invites)

view.title: Invite counts
view.text:
{user} has **{total}** invites.
Joined through them: {invited} · left: {left} · fake: {fake} · bonus: {bonus}

leaderboard.title: Invite leaderboard
leaderboard.footer: Page {page} · updated at most once a minute

who.none: Mewvo has no join record for {user} (they joined before invite tracking was on, or while Mewvo was offline).
who.notCounted: Not counted again: they had joined through the same inviter before.

list.none: Nobody has joined through {user}'s invites yet.
list.header: Latest members who joined through {user}'s invites (up to {count}):

bonus.range: That would take the bonus past ±100,000. Nothing was changed.
bonus.done: Bonus of {user} is now {bonus}. Their total is **{total}**.
bonus.doneNoTotal: Saved: the bonus of {user} is now {bonus}. Their total could not be read right now (database not responding).

reset.title: Reset invite counts
reset.askAll: Reset the invite counts of **everyone** in this server? Only joins from now on will count and every bonus starts again at 0. Nothing is deleted.
reset.askUser: Reset the invite count of {user}? Only joins from now on will count and their bonus starts again at 0. Nothing is deleted.
reset.notYours: These buttons belong to the admin who ran /invites reset.
reset.noAdmin: You need the Administrator permission for this. Nothing was changed.
reset.doneAll: Done. The invite counts of the whole server start again from now.
reset.doneUser: Done. The invite count of {user} starts again from now.

setup.on: Invite tracking is **on** in this server.
setup.off: Invite tracking is **off** in this server.
setup.noManageServer: Mewvo needs the **Manage Server** permission to read the invite list. Without it no join can be matched to an invite.
setup.loading: The invite list is still loading; joins right now are recorded as unknown.
setup.noManageRoles: Milestone roles are set, but Mewvo lacks **Manage Roles**, so it cannot give them.
setup.link: Settings, milestone roles and the full lists: {url}
setup.noLink: Settings and milestone roles are on the dashboard (Invites page).
